item.title: Annual ZayDay toy drive brings Christmas cheer to Children’s Hospital
item.description: Santa made an early stop to the Wellstar Children’s Hospital of Georgia, Tuesday afternoon, as the ZayDay Foundation brought in one of its biggest Christmas hauls to date. item.title: Graniteville teen killed in Christmas Eve wreck
item.description: A Graniteville teen was tragically killed on Christmas Eve after wrecking on Connector Road, authorities said. The post Graniteville teen killed in Christmas Eve wreck appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Lamar Jackson doubtful and Jordan Love questionable for Ravens-Packers game Saturday
item.description: Lamar Jackson is listed as doubtful for Baltimore's game against the Green Bay Packers on Saturday night as he continues to deal with a back injury that knocked him out of the game against the New England Patriots last weekend. item.title: Trammell Crow company sells Appling data center property for $475 million
item.description: Trammell Crow, the Atlanta real estate company developing the data center facility at the Appling property formerly owned by the Economic Development Authority of Columbia County (EDACC), has sold the property to what appears to be the end user for the project, according to documents obtained by TAP.
